maxwell_hodge_boundary.interpretation: Maxwell and Hodge-Maxwell no longer depend on Fin n. The exact GRU carrier is arbitrary; continuity, global encode/decode, Maxwell equations, recurrent conjugacy, and Hodge involution prerequisites are explicit proof obligations.
maxwell_hodge_boundary.universal_continuous_boundary: The carrier-polymorphic theorem can be instantiated by an infinite-dimensional Maxwell function space once the caller supplies the exact differential-form/function-space semantics, continuity witnesses, encoder/decoder, conjugacy, and an explicit dimension predicate. It does not infer any of those from Set alone.
maxwell_hodge_boundary.global_injectivity: The exact encode/decode laws yield a StateIsomorphism and an explicit global encode-injectivity theorem.
maxwell_hodge_boundary.z_role: ℤ remains the exact algebraic carrier for the canonical learner where applicable; it is not a universal carrier for arbitrary continuous Maxwell function spaces.
maxwell_hodge_boundary.fin_dependency_pruning: Continuous Hodge-Maxwell composition has no Fin n dependency; finite-function transport is not a prerequisite for the carrier-polymorphic representation.
maxwell_hodge_boundary.noninjectivity_boundary: An explicit encoder collision contradicts the connected exact representation certificate. A universal collision theorem for all continuous finite-dimensional Maxwell spaces remains unproved because no topological finite-dimensionality primitive exists on the current Agda surface.

arbitrary_finite_coordinate_composition.quantification: ∀ Scalar : Set, ∀ n : Nat, for every supplied connected representation and exact-length coordinate isomorphism
arbitrary_finite_coordinate_composition.coordinate_carrier: FiniteCoordinateList Scalar n = Σ (xs : List Scalar) (λ xs → length xs ≡ n)
arbitrary_finite_coordinate_composition.result: global injectivity of the learner coordinate observation
arbitrary_finite_coordinate_composition.boundary: Exact finite-coordinate carrier without Fin. No vector-space/module dimension axioms or universal existence theorem for physical Maxwell solution coordinates are claimed.

infinite_dimensional_promotion.quantification: arbitrary GRU carrier and arbitrary Maxwell Solution carrier, conditioned only on a caller-supplied InfiniteDimensional predicate/witness
infinite_dimensional_promotion.agda_boundary: No vector-space/module/basis/dimension implementation is inferred. The promotion is intentionally carrier-agnostic.
infinite_dimensional_promotion.transport: Existing learner-to-solution inverse plus global Hodge-Maxwell encode/decode injectivity transport the exact learner state; the existing prefix+horizon-regret endpoint is inherited unchanged.
infinite_dimensional_promotion.existence_boundary: No theorem claims every infinite-dimensional Maxwell function space admits the supplied exact GRU representation.

maxwell_hodge_boundary.finite_dimensional_boundary: Finite-coordinate transport is conditionally proved with an exact-length list coordinate isomorphism. A general vector-space/module finite-dimensionality and universal coordinate-existence theorem remains outside the current surface.
